name: Catherine E. Romancia
original_name: カトレーヌ=エ=ロマンシア
source:
Yggdrasil Magical Academy Third Year
Class: Archpriest

A third-year student at Yggdrasil Girls' Magical Academy, and a member of the healthcare committee in charge of the other students' physical examinations.  

Her family runs a primary school as well as a church, so she has a strong sense of compassion and faith, and she specializes in healing magic. Catherine is a real stickler for the rules, but she can get surprisingly bold with her “confessions.” 

A gentle and caring girl, she loves doting over the [url=/c64356]protagonist[/url] like a little brother. When her motherly instincts are roused, and during certain times of the month, she produces copious amounts of milk.  

Inexperienced when it comes to romance, she often turns to her classmate [url=/c64072]Kaguya[/url] for relationship advice.
